about_the_game:
"Internet Fisherman" is an idle fishing game where you can obtain rare fish every 2 hours and add them to your Steam inventory.

Players can feed fish to cats to increase affection, and they will appear on the affection leaderboard, competing with other players.

Rare fish can be either fed to cats or listed on the Steam Community Market for trading with other players.

Affection unlocks cats:

  • Tiger Cat = 1

  • Black Cat = 5000

  • White Cat = 100000

  • Demon Cat = ?

  • Bat Cat = ?

I have carefully crafted an immersive atmosphere and background music for the game.

I hope you enjoy playing!
